$comment: The EarthRanger tools Atlas (and, with WebMCP, any browser agent) may call. The contract between das-web-react and otus: das-web-react owns this file, and otus keeps a copy (agents/otus/skills/show_in_app/tools.json) with a test that every step to_view.py writes validates against it. validate.js checks each call against its inputSchema (so unknown tools, and unknown keys, which every schema's additionalProperties: false forbids, are refused) and then adds the rules JSON Schema cannot say, or says only in a dialect some consumers do not read: since, until and time must each be a real instant (no month 13, 2026-02-30 or 24:00, and an offset of at most 23:59) and are normalized to UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ); since must not be after until (equal is allowed); coordinates and lnglat are [longitude, latitude] and bbox is [longitude, latitude, longitude, latitude], each longitude in -180..180 and latitude in -90..90; bbox needs west <= east and south <= north; ids (every value with the uuid pattern, alone or in a list) are lower-cased; duplicate items of every list but coordinates, lnglat and bbox are dropped (ids after lower-casing). Change the two together.

tools.name: events-filter
tools.description: Set the Events feed filter in EarthRanger (the map's event markers follow it). Fields left out keep the user's current value; give until: null for a window that runs to now. Opens the Events feed unless open is false.

since.description: Window start, an ISO 8601 time with its offset.

anyOf.description: An ISO 8601 time with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T00:00:00+03:00.

until.description: Window end, an ISO 8601 time with its offset, or null for open-ended (now).

event_types.description: Event type ids; an empty list shows every type, at most 500; duplicates are ignored.

priority.description: Priorities to show (300 red, 200 amber, 100 green, 0 grey); an empty list shows all.

text.description: Search text, at most 100 characters (UTF-16 units); an empty string clears it.

reported_by.description: Reporter ids; an empty list shows every reporter, at most 500; duplicates are ignored.

open.description: Navigate to the Events feed (default true).

tools.name: patrols-filter
tools.description: Set the Patrols feed filter in EarthRanger. Fields left out keep the user's current value; until: null means the end of today. Opens the Patrols feed only when open is true.

since.description: Window start, an ISO 8601 time with its offset.

anyOf.description: An ISO 8601 time with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T00:00:00+03:00.

until.description: Window end, or null for the end of today.

status.description: Patrol statuses to show; an empty list shows all.

patrol_types.description: Patrol type ids; an empty list shows every type, at most 500; duplicates are ignored.

leaders.description: Leader subject ids; an empty list shows every leader, at most 500; duplicates are ignored.

text.description: Search text, at most 100 characters (UTF-16 units); an empty string clears it.

open.description: Navigate to the Patrols feed (default false).

tools.name: open-event
tools.description: Open one event's detail view in EarthRanger and centre the map on it.

tools.name: open-patrol
tools.description: Open one patrol's detail view in EarthRanger and pin its track.

tools.name: subject-popup
tools.description: Show a subject's popup on the EarthRanger map, flying to its last position, and optionally its track.

tools.name: subject-track
tools.description: Pin the tracks of up to 20 subjects on the EarthRanger map. A window that runs to now is since alone; until without since is ignored. A window changes the user's settings and the result says how: one ending now (or within the last hour) sets the track length to the whole days since since; one ending earlier sets the events filter's date range to the window and turns the time slider on at its end.

ids.description: Subject ids, at most 20; duplicates are ignored.

since.description: Window start, an ISO 8601 time with its offset.

anyOf.description: An ISO 8601 time with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T00:00:00+03:00.

until.description: Window end, an ISO 8601 time with its offset, or null for open-ended (now).

tools.name: subject-at-time
tools.description: Show where a subject was at a given time, on its track in EarthRanger. This sets the user's events filter date range to the time ±1 day (ending no later than now) and turns the time slider on at the time; the result says the range.

time.description: An ISO 8601 time with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T00:00:00+03:00.

tools.name: subject-heatmap
tools.description: Turn on a heatmap of up to 200 subjects' positions on the EarthRanger map. A window that runs to now is since alone; until without since is ignored. A window changes the user's settings and the result says how: one ending now (or within the last hour) sets the track length to the whole days since since; one ending earlier sets the events filter's date range to the window and turns the time slider on at its end.

ids.description: Subject ids, at most 200; duplicates are ignored.

since.description: Window start, an ISO 8601 time with its offset.

anyOf.description: An ISO 8601 time with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T00:00:00+03:00.

until.description: Window end, an ISO 8601 time with its offset, or null for open-ended (now).

tools.name: report-heatmap
tools.description: Turn the heatmap of the event (report) markers on the EarthRanger map on or off.

tools.name: subjects-visibility
tools.description: Show or hide subjects on the EarthRanger map: exactly one of only (show these, hide the rest), hide, or show. Lasts until the page reloads.

only.description: Subject ids, at most 500; duplicates are ignored.

hide.description: Subject ids, at most 500; duplicates are ignored.

show.description: Subject ids, at most 500; duplicates are ignored.

tools.name: show-feature
tools.description: Show a spatial feature (a place, fence or area) on the EarthRanger map and fit the map to it.

tools.name: show-analyzer
tools.description: Show an analyzer's outline on the EarthRanger map and fit the map to it.

tools.name: layers-search
tools.description: Search the EarthRanger Map Layers panel; matching groups expand. Lasts until the page reloads.

text.description: Search text, at most 100 characters (UTF-16 units).

tools.name: jump-to
tools.description: Move the EarthRanger map camera to a point; the browser's Back button returns it.

tools.name: fit-bounds
tools.description: Fit the EarthRanger map camera to a box; the browser's Back button returns it.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in degrees: longitudes -180..180, latitudes -90..90, west <= east and south <= north.

tools.name: open-record
tools.description: Open an event or patrol in EarthRanger, as a link to it would.

lnglat.description: [longitude, latitude] to centre the map on, as the record link's ?lnglat= does.
